hypothesis.title: Futures Basis and Next-Day Spot Returns on the Vietnamese VN30 Index
hypothesis.statement: A higher VN30 futures basis at the close predicts a higher VN30 index return on the next trading day.
hypothesis.null_hypothesis: The coefficient of the next-day VN30 return on the closing futures basis is zero.
hypothesis.alt_hypothesis: The coefficient is positive (HAC one-sided p < 0.05 and circular-shift placebo p < 0.05).
hypothesis.methodology: Predictive regression with Newey-West HAC errors and circular-shift placebo
hypothesis.metric_name: beta of next-day VN30 return on futures basis
